senses.nuances: 此处仅记录已见的人名用法，不认定其为官方马来语词条。人名通常写作 Mehra。上述马来语释义为编辑说明，并非 DBP 原文；以下组合与例句为教学编写，不代表已核实的高频搭配。人名用例见 [My Mehra 图书简介](https://msp-fictions.elib.com.my/index.php/book/details/365087)。

etymology.historical_story: Mehra appears as a character's name in the Malay-language novel My Mehra. This establishes a literary use of the name, but does not establish a Malay common-word meaning or a historical borrowing route. Its origin, pronunciation and Jawi spelling remain unverified for this entry.
